PROPOSAL DESCRIPTION: The project is to regrade and pave an existing trailer lot in use by the United States Postal Service. The lot contains areas that are already paved  as well as gravel and undeveloped areas. The intent is to remove and replace material as necessary to reconstruct the paved parking lot. Tallest anticipated construction equipment on site will be an excavator with a total boom height of 20 feet. In order to assess the existing soil conditions on site  a geotechnical investigation will be performed prior to construction. To accomplish this task  a drill rig will be brought on site to drill boreholes. The drill rig to be used for this work will be the CME-850X  with a mast height of 26 feet. The soil assessment will inform the required sub-grade depth  as well as which site material can be reused. Due to the low mast height  PND Engineers does not anticipate the geotechnical work posing significant risk to air traffic in the area.
